# 六字大陀羅尼呪經

**ID:** T1046
**Volume:** T20
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1046

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The third anonymous Eastern-Jìn variant of the *Liùzì* (six-syllable) dhāraṇī tradition. Together with [KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242) (T1044) and [KR6j0243](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0243)–[KR6j0244](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0244) (T1045A/B), this text completes the cluster of pre-Tang Chinese translations of the *ṣaḍ-akṣarī-vidyā* tradition.

**Abstract**

This recension's distinguishing feature is the substitution of *dà tuóluóní zhòu* 大陀羅尼呪 ("great dhāraṇī-spell") for the *shénzhòuwáng* 神呪王 ("divine spell-king") of T1045A/B and the *zhòuwáng* 呪王 ("spell-king") of T1044 — a terminological variant that may reflect a slightly later redaction in which the *tuóluóní* (dhāraṇī) terminology had become more widespread relative to the older *zhòu* (spell) idiom. Doctrinal content and dhāraṇī itself remain closely related across the four Eastern-Jìn six-syllable texts. For full discussion see [KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242).
